answer.answer: The study aimed to confirm the anti-invasion and anti-migration effects of down-regulation of Notch1 combined with interleukin (IL)-24 in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) cells. The invasion and migration capacities of HCC cells were detected by wound healing assays, and the distance of wound closure correlated with the concentrations of IL-24 and GSI-I. Furthermore, the apoptotic rate of HepG2 cells was observed following GSI-I/IL-24 combined treatment, and caspase-3/7 activity was increased in the presence of siNotch1 plus IL-24 treatment.

The apoptotic rate of HepG2 cells was observed following GSI-I/IL-24 combined treatment.
Caspase-3/7 activity was increased in the presence of siNotch1 plus IL-24 treatment.
